title: dev-run/3: one development-run admission in data/evaluation/runs.jsonl
description: Development-run accounting. Current rows separate provider subtotals, unknown-cost attempts and explicit incomplete-trace admission bounds. Historical rows preserve the original accounting basis and figures.

study.description: The GitHub issue that owns the study, e.g. 372 or 382.

label.description: The run's short name in its study's dated record (e.g. T1, or the run name).

start.description: The manifest's start label: S1 to S99.

lineage.description: The manifest's lineage label (e.g. L1), or null for a single-run admission.

ended.description: The receipt's ended_wall as a UTC timestamp.

attempts.description: Observed HTTP starts for current runs, possibly a lower bound when the trace is incomplete. Historical rows retain the count from their original evidence.

wall_seconds.description: The receipt's elapsed_seconds, rounded to the second.

spend_usd.description: Received provider subtotal for current rows. Historical rows retain the frozen amount.

provider_usd.description: Provider-reported subtotal on current rows. Historical rows retain the original decomposition, when recorded.

unpriced_attempts.description: Charged attempts without a provider record, or null when not recorded.

unpriced_attempt_usd.description: Historical per-attempt bound when recorded. Current unpriced attempts retain unknown charges.

unpriced_recall_attempt_usd.description: Historical per-attempt recall bound when recorded. Current unpriced attempts retain unknown charges.

accounting_basis.description: Historical frozen figures, complete trace with provider-reported subtotal, or incomplete trace with a separate explicit admission bound.

spend_upper_bound_usd.description: Optional explicit admission bound for an incomplete trace. This field does not report provider cost.
